title: Who Are You When No One Is Watching? | A Discipline Short Film
lines: 5:00 a.m. No one will check if he gets up.
That's the test. Who are you when no one is watching?
He stands. He laces his shoes. He steps out into the dark.
Integrity is doing the work when no one is looking.
Discipline is keeping the promise when no one would know you broke it.
Keep going. The sun is coming for you.
